result_text:
`all_files.zip` now gets its entry names and its file lookups from the configured aspect names, so renaming the build and deployment aspect no longer breaks the export. I only compiled the `reports` module (it builds cleanly). I didn't run any tests or try a renamed config.

The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. It replaces the five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals with a loop over the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects. For each aspect it calls `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same helper that names the loose text files. It reads the file under that name and uses the same name as the zip entry.

With the default configuration the entries are unchanged: `aspect_main.txt`, `aspect_test.txt`, `aspect_generated.txt`, `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`, `aspect_other.txt`, in that order. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` is written as before, since the failed read no longer stops it.

I left `LandscapeAnalyzer` alone. It also hard-codes `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt` (lines 280–284), so a landscape run would still miss a renamed aspect's file list. That's outside this task.
